CACI is seeking a Junior Software Developer to support the modernization of enterprise business solutions used by NASA. The role develops, tests, and maintains the Agency Data Catalog and Open Innovation Products, working with Python, databases, APIs, and cloud technologies as part of a remote Agile team.
Computer Software
Hiring Manager
Archi Nagwani
Responsibilities
Develop, test, and maintain software solutions using established engineering practices, including version control, code reviews, documentation, and automated testing
Implement features and enhancements for the Agency Data Catalog and Open Innovation Products under the guidance of senior team members
Develop and maintain integrations between enterprise systems using APIs, data ingestion pipelines, and database connections
Support cloud-based development, deployment, and operational activities within secure environments
Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and product stakeholders to deliver user-focused solutions
Troubleshoot application issues, investigate defects, and participate in root cause analysis and resolution
Create and maintain technical documentation, including user stories, implementation notes, and configuration documentation
Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives
Learn and apply engineering practices related to CI/CD, infrastructure automation, code quality, and secure software development
Work effectively within a fully remote team by communicating proactively, managing workload independently, and meeting commitments with minimal day-to-day supervision
Maintain a professional home-office environment with reliable internet connectivity and the ability to participate in virtual meetings, collaboration, and development activities

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Relevant experience or certifications may be considered in place of a degree
Experience developing software with Python through professional experience, internships, academic coursework, or personal projects
Experience working with relational databases and writing SQL queries
Familiarity with software development lifecycle concepts, source control systems such as Git, and Agile development methodologies
Basic understanding of web services, REST APIs, and data-driven applications
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Ability to approach technical challenges and unfamiliar problems with persistence, resourcefulness, and a commitment to resolution
Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them effectively in a collaborative team environment
Strong personal accountability and ability to work independently in a remote-first environment while maintaining consistent progress and communication
Attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality work
Ability to obtain and maintain a NASA Public Trust background investigation
Preferred
Internship, academic, or project experience developing software applications or data-driven solutions
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools
Exposure to data management, data catalogs, metadata, or data governance concepts
Familiarity with Databricks, Microsoft Purview, Apache Airflow, GitLab, or similar technologies
Experience supporting the federal government

Fully remote working arrangement.
Healthcare and wellness benefits.
Financial and retirement benefits.
Family support benefits.
